- 14 years Location Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (CHN) Job Summary Job Title: Server Hardware Support Engineer / Server Break-Fix Specialist Shift Requirement: Must be flexible and willing to work in 24/7 rotational shifts. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, as they will be interacting with technical teams and potentially clients. Technical Skills & Experience We need an engineer with strong experience in hands-on technical troubleshooting and providing hardware break-fix solutions for servers. Here is the breakdown of the hardware expertise we are looking for: High Priority (Must-Have): HP Pro Liant servers (Deep troubleshooting and break-fix experience) Dell Power Edge servers (Deep troubleshooting and break-fix experience) Medium Priority (Highly Desirable): Lenovo servers Cisco UCS (Unified Computing System) Low Priority (Good to Have / Add-on): IBM servers Key Responsibilities for the Role Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex server hardware issues. Replacing faulty components (Motherboards, RAM, Hard Drives, Power Supplies, etc.) as part of break-fix operations. Managing server management tools (like HP i LO, Dell i DRAC). Collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve hardware downtime efficiently.
